title: Seas and Ocean Deeps
intro: Ten questions on the ocean: its basins, its average depth, the Challenger Deep and the biggest seas, bays and gulfs. Every answer shows its source.

questions.prompt: Which is the largest ocean basin?
questions.explain: NOAA ranks the Pacific first, then the Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic oceans.

questions.prompt: Which ocean is the third largest?
questions.explain: In NOAA's ranking by basin size the Indian Ocean is third, after the Pacific and the Atlantic.

questions.prompt: About how much of the Earth's surface does the ocean cover?
questions.explain: NOAA gives about 71 percent as the share of the Earth's surface covered by ocean.

questions.prompt: What is the average depth of the ocean?
questions.explain: NOAA gives 3,682 m (12,080 ft) as the average depth of the ocean.

questions.prompt: In which ocean is the Challenger Deep, the deepest known part of the sea floor?
questions.explain: The Challenger Deep lies beneath the western Pacific Ocean, at the southern end of the Mariana Trench.

questions.prompt: About how deep is the Challenger Deep?
Which of these seas has the largest area?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives the Philippine Sea about 5,000,000 km2, twice the Mediterranean (2,500,000 km2).

questions.prompt: Which of these seas is the deepest?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives the Philippine Sea a maximum depth of 10,911 m, the Caribbean 7,686 m.

questions.prompt: Which of these bays has the largest area?
questions.explain: The Bay of Bengal covers about 2,172,000 km2, Hudson Bay 1,243,000 km2.

questions.prompt: Which of these gulfs has the largest area?
questions.explain: The Gulf of Mexico covers about 1,550,000 km2; the Gulf of Thailand 320,000 km2.
